rows.grounds: compound denoting one whose lifespan is a thousand years
compound object meaning the end of the scriptures

items.question: Does even a goddess with thousand-year lifespan reach scripture's end?
items.inference: Even immense lifespan does not suffice to exhaust scripture.
uncertainties: Whether devi is vocative or nominative in context.
items.plain_english: O goddess, one with a thousand-year lifespan does not indeed reach the end of the scriptures.

rows.grounds: compound expressing duration of restless senses
interrogative adverb asking source or possibility

items.question: Whence truth-discourse while the senses remain restless?
premises: Truth-discourse is questioned during that duration.
The correlative links duration to discourse.
items.inference: Restless senses obstruct or delay truth-discourse.
uncertainties: Whether tattvakathā is subject or object in the rhetorical question.
items.plain_english: As long as there is restlessness of the senses, so long, whence is discourse on truth?
